item.title: Gaza: WHO appeals for massive aid influx ahead of winter
item.description: Repeated delays in bringing lifesaving medicines, prosthetics and more from Israel into Gaza risk having devastating consequences on Palestinians who urgently need them in the war-torn enclave, the UN World Health Organization (WHO) said on Friday.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Ebola response faces setback as transit centre burns down in DR Congo camp
item.description: The enormous challenge of halting the spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) just became even harder after a key transit centre for patients requiring treatment burned down in Ituri province.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: DRC: Early access to care and oxygen decisive for Ebola patients’ survival – WHO
item.description: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), health workers fighting the country’s largest-ever Ebola outbreak are struggling to overcome critical challenges to patient care, the UN World Health Organization (WHO) warned on Tuesday.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: DR Congo Ebola emergency: Calls grow for urgent humanitarian access
item.description: Aid teams trying to keep deadly Ebola disease from spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) are increasingly concerned about ongoing fighting and violence that has forced thousands of people to flee a displacement camp in the vast, resource-rich east of the country.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: LIVE: Six years on from COVID-19, is the world ready for the next pandemic?
item.description: COVID-19 killed millions, shattered health systems and brought the global economy to a virtual standstill. World leaders are meeting Friday to review the lessons learned and cement a new approach to prevention and preparation for the next pandemic. Hopes are high that a World Health Organization-led international agreement can move forward.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: UN health agency calls for investment boost to save young lives from cancer
item.description: More children and young people are beating cancer, but progress remains uneven across regions and age groups, highlighting the need for increased investment to boost survival rates.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak toll exceeds 3,700 deaths
item.description: More than 130 days into the latest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), health experts said on Wednesday that response efforts have been scaled up significantly and “the first encouraging signs of progress” are now being seen.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Ebola vaccine research programme begins in DR Congo
item.description: An Ebola vaccine programme is underway in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), involving frontline health workers and others involved in the response.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: The race to build a pandemic-proof world
item.description: Six years after COVID-19 killed millions, battered health systems, disrupted lives and brought the global economy to a virtual standstill, the world is still grappling with how we can prepare better for the next pandemic.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Women and girls pay high price in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
item.description: The deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has taken a disproportionate toll on women and girls, many of whom are on the frontlines caring for patients as well as their own families despite the high risk of infection.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Ebola responders grapple with widening outbreak in DR Congo
item.description: The deadly Ebola virus outbreak in DR Congo continues to spread across the vast country despite some success in containing it, aid officials said on Tuesday, in a renewed call for international support to help responders on the ground.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Ebola response in eastern DR Congo must include food assistance, WFP says
item.description: As Ebola sweeps across the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), ensuring families meet their basic food needs is crucial to halt the spread of the deadly disease.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Tobacco use can undermine fertility, UN health agency warns
item.description: Smoking very likely makes it harder to have a baby, the UN World Health Organization (WHO) warned in a new publication issued on Tuesday, highlighting that women who smoke have a 40 per cent higher risk of infertility compared to non-smokers.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Repeated attacks on humanitarian warehouses put vital medical aid at risk in Ukraine: WHO
item.description: A new airstrike overnight damaged one of the main warehouses used by the World Health Organization (WHO) in Ukraine to store humanitarian medical supplies in the Kyiv region, the UN agency said on Friday.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Response must outpace spread of Ebola: UN relief chief
item.description: The world must move faster to contain an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) that is growing exponentially, the UN’s Emergency Relief Coordinator warned on Tuesday.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: UN chief condemns ‘indifference’ as Ebola cases mount in DR Congo
item.description: The Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) requires “urgent” action and funding to rein in its alarming spread, the UN Secretary-General told reporters at UN Headquarters on Thursday.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: More health workers, stronger systems: Africa’s new ambitious goal
item.description: Facing a projected shortage of more than six million health professionals by 2035, African countries are stepping up efforts to strengthen their workforce, with a new decade-long plan announced on Wednesday during a meeting of health ministers in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: 100 days of Ebola and the race to stop the spread
item.description: A hundred days after the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak was declared, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is facing an epidemic of an unprecedented scale and efforts must grow to contain the spread in the eastern region and across borders, UN agencies warned on Monday.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak spreading exponentially, UN responders warn
item.description: As the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo’s history continued spreading on Friday, UN responders renewed their urgent appeal for immediate international support, with existing funding for lifesaving work critically low.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Mpox: Children account for half of suspected cases in Guinea-Bissau
item.description: Children, who are particularly vulnerable to the disease, account for half of the 46 suspected mpox cases identified in Guinea-Bissau – with 16 of them under the age of four.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: DR Congo receives 70,000 Ebola vaccine doses as Bundibugyo outbreak spreads
item.description: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) will receive 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine from the UN’s international vaccine coordination group (ICG) to protect frontline communities against the Ebola virus disease.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Ebola: Motorbike riders carrying the sick may hold key to response boost
item.description: From the frontlines of the deadliest-ever Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the UN World Health Organization (WHO) shared details on Tuesday of a massive push for community engagement, a day after yet another ambulance attack.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Ebola outbreak becomes deadliest in DR Congo’s history
item.description: The Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is now the deadliest the country has ever faced, the UN’s World Health Organization (WHO) said on Monday.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Former rebel fighters join campaign against Ebola in the DR Congo
item.description: Demobilised former combatants are actively joining the fight against Ebola by participating in public information campaigns in the east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: ‘Ebola is winning’: Epidemic now killing one person every 30 minutes
item.description: The Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) – the fastest-growing on record and on track to become the deadliest – is killing one person every 30 minutes.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: An attack on healthcare every six hours, and no one held to account
item.description: Across the world, healthcare has suffered more than 10,000 attacks in the past eight years, including during the brutal conflict in Ukraine and efforts to contain the current Ebola outbreak spreading rapidly in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Meth trafficking across Middle East becoming more advanced, UNODC warns
item.description: Authorities in Iran intercepted 3,663 kilogrammes of methamphetamines headed for Europe and the Persian Gulf in the first quarter of 2026, according to the UN’s drugs and crime fighting agency (UNODC).
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Ebola tracing improves in DR Congo – but the virus is still winning the race
item.description: Health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) are tracking a growing share of people exposed to Ebola, but the epidemic in the country's restive east continues to outpace their ability to find and isolate the sick, the World Health Organization (WHO) has warned.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: Cholera spreads across borders in West and Central Africa
item.description: Cholera is spreading rapidly across West and Central Africa, with active outbreaks now in six countries and millions of children at growing risk, UN children’s agency UNICEF has said.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories

item.title: WHO chief voices concern over Trump Administration’s executive order on vaccines
item.description: The head of the World Health Organization (WHO) on Wednesday upheld the safety of childhood vaccines in response to a new directive from the White House to overhaul the recommended inoculation schedule.
item.source: UN News - Global perspective Human stories
